entities.name: Trijiro
entities.description: Centaur zuriv (shaman-chief) of Vor Golozar's tribe on Ravnica.

entities.name: Vor Golozar
entities.description: Centaur ordered by Trijiro to accompany Crix to Cauldron.

entities.name: Utvara
entities.description: Township Trijiro visited disguised as a beggar.

entities.name: Melisk
entities.description: Controlled the taj that presumably slew the village.

events.summary: Trijiro visited Utvara disguised as a beggar to trade information with Agrus Kos.
events.quote: He often wandered to the Utvara township under the disguise of a beggar

events.summary: Trijiro ordered Vor Golozar to accompany Crix to Cauldron.
events.quote: He ordered Vor Golozar to accompany the goblin messenger Crix to Cauldron after her capture.

events.summary: Trijiro was presumably slain by the taj under Melisk's control with his village.
events.quote: he was presumably slain by the taj under the control of Melisk

relations.note: He was zuriv of Vor Golozar's tribe.
relations.quote: Trijiro was a centaur zuriv (shaman-chief) of Vor Golozar 's tribe on Ravnica .
